title: CodeGraph query route is unavailable in isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: The required codegraph explore query had no usable index or launcher in this worktree; initializing an index is disallowed by the lane rules, so shared traversal discovery fell back to manual rg. Provide a read-only query route or provision the index during worktree setup.

title: VIXEN CodegenTool needs ICU provisioning or invariant globalization setting
body: Queued command without the override, bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent tiebreak --resource build --label baseline-build-retry -- nice -n 10 cmake --build ../build/wsl -j8, failed because .NET could not find a valid ICU package. Using env DOTNET_SYSTEM_GLOBALIZATION_INVARIANT=1 let CodegenTool restore/build and the scoped target build proceed; provision ICU or set a supported globalization mode in the CMake CodegenTool route.

title: First VIXEN configure leaves spirv-reflect header unavailable to the initial build
body: Queued baseline build bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent tiebreak --resource build --label baseline-build -- nice -n 10 cmake --build ../build/wsl -j8 failed at SpirvReflector.cpp:3 because spirv_reflect.h was missing. Repeating the documented queued vixen-wsl configure with VIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG, then rebuilding, got past this error without source changes. Make the FetchContent/include setup complete on the first configure/build.

title: Add a registered compile check for the RTQuery traversal shader variant
body: The focused CMake GPU targets compiled BodyInstanceRayMarch.comp with default and B1 macros, but did not compile the optional RayQueryTraversal branch. I had to run a queued manual glslc command with -DVIXEN_RTQUERY_TRAVERSAL=1 and Vulkan 1.3 flags to verify it. Add a CMake shader target or focused test compile so this backend stays covered by routine verification.

title: Add an offscreen Cornell render-and-hash witness
body: The requested Cornell pixel comparison and same-image-twice check could not run: the existing Cornell capture uses the window/swapchain app, DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY are unset, and Xvfb is absent. HeadlessUiGraph captures UI but does not exercise TraceWorld. Add an offscreen Cornell render test that writes into the build tree and can compare two captures byte-for-byte.
